test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "construction."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word** "construction" **is appropriate for the blank because it suggests that the colonizers repurposed the land not only for dumping rubbish but also for building or developing sites that would benefit them.
 
• In this context,** "construction"** implies the creation of structures or developments on the land for the colonizers' own improvement or advantage. (उपनिवेशवादियों के स्वयं के सुधार या लाभ के लिए भूमि पर संरचनाओं या विकास का निर्माण)
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

Colonialism had a great impact on the lives of the aboriginal Australians who were eventually subjugated__ by the whites with all power and privilege. The colonisers turned their land into rubbish pits and __**construction**__ sites for their own betterment. The aborigines were often ______ (3) ______ as sub-humans with low status and dirty habits. The whites not only displaced the tribes off their homeland but also ______ (4) ______ the beauty and balance of the natural world. An increase in deforestation and destruction of traditional land led ______ (5) ______ like emu, eagle, and kangaroo, among many others to dwindle over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Dating: **the social activity of spending time with someone to develop a romantic or potentially romantic relationship. (रोमांटिक या संभावित रोमांटिक संबंध विकसित करने के लिए किसी के साथ समय बिताने की सामाजिक गतिविधि)
 
• **Halting: **stopping often while you are saying or doing something. (जब आप कुछ कह रहे हों या कुछ कर रहे हों तो बार-बार रुकना)
 
• **Recreation: **activity done for enjoyment when one is not working. (जब कोई काम नहीं कर रहा हो तो आनंद के लिए की जाने वाली गतिविधि)
